Key survives new biometric enrollment. Attacker enrolls their fingerprint \u2014 their biometric now unlocks the key without the real user knowing.

Key accessible to any enrolled biometric, past or future. New fingerprint added after key creation = immediate unauthorized access.
On invalidation, user forced through full re-authentication flow (password + 2FA) before new key is generated and old data migrated.
